title: The end of a lawless paradise? Local government seeks to take back control of Corsican islet
subhead: Cavallo, a little gem of the Lavezzi archipelago, has always sparked envy. Once the scene of wild parties, it drew the international jet set before becoming a target for nationalists and organized crime groups. In June, the local government launched an offensive to regain control of the port and open the island up to tourists.

title: Sweden's pro-Russian ties embarrass the far right
subhead: A scandal involving an employee of Sweden's Parliament has shaken the ruling alliance just ahead of the September 13 elections. The employee, who is the partner of a senior official of the Sweden Democrats party, faces accusations of spreading disinformation for Russia's benefit.

title: France's cultural and lifestyle highlights this autumn, from Paris to Toulon
subhead: Le Monde's pick for cultural highlights in France include a pop art tour on the island of Porquerolles, an immersive dive into Vietnamese cultures in Paris and an exhibition in Toulon exploring textile innovations in design.

title: The letters from two Ukrainian sisters: 'Stay in bed or take shelter elsewhere: a life-or-death decision'
subhead: Sasha and Olga Kurovska are two Ukrainian sisters, one lives in Kyiv, the other in Paris. Faced with Russian strikes on civilian infrastructure, Sasha admires her fellow citizens' determination to never give up, while Olga, fresh from a month-long stay in Ukraine, better understands her sister's reactions to the constant threat of bombing.
